snippet.title: Kill The Music - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Kill The Music gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Get a fresh look at Kill The Music in this latest trailer for the upcoming rhythm action roguelite game about defeating hordes of enemies with musical instruments. The new Kill The Music trailer shows gameplay, the characters, enemies you'll fight, and more. Kill The Music will be available on PC on August 21, 2025.

#KillTheMusic #GameTrailers #indie
